runs.title: Calibrated MoSca initializer
runs.notes: Calibrated studio test, 20 real saved MoSca states over ~3 seconds. Both controls use the same two-view-informed depth/intrinsics calibration and initializer. The one-view control optimizes camera00 only; the two-view model optimizes cameras00 and24 into shared geometry at each timestamp with temporal regularization. Camera02 images were introduced only after both checkpoints were frozen; no held-out refitting. Use Recorded viewpoint to compare the exact calibrated cameras without changing time. Second-view training fidelity improves; held-out view remains visibly fragmented and person-region image error worsens. Body/room holes, unseen surfaces and extrapolation remain. This is experimental refinement of saved MoSca Gaussians, not a jointly trained upstream MoSca scaffold or handheld-phone pipeline. DC appearance, black backfill, no point subsampling. See calibrated-multiview/result.md.
